Title: [LSJ] need official ruling on damage prevention

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Hardrock Llewynyth wrote:
>
> Looks like i will be the official rules-monger for our local playgroup, so
> i need to get an official ruling on preventing agg. damage with fortitude
> cards. can it be done with cards like Skin of Rock?

Yes. Damage is damage. Damage prevention cards can be used to
prevent normal and/or aggravated damage, unless card text
explicitly restricts itself to one or the other.

Just like presses are presses. Presses can be used to continue
and to end, unless card text explicity restricts the press to just
one of the uses.

> Also, is there a decent referance for DCI rules/cardand rules errata? i
> have printed out everything from the WOtC website, but was wondering if
> there was anything better.

No. DCI has issued no errata, and has only added a handful of rules:

* No Repeat Actions
* PAs burned for votes are not replaced until the end of the turn
* Libraries cannot include any cards on the banned list
* <some timing stuff>

This is spelled out very clearly in the DCI rules sheet available from
the WotC web site.
